name: m41b_width_retrain
question: Do the 43 appended encoder columns (M41 100-104, M42 105-114, M41b 115-142) make the net stronger once it is trained wide enough to see them? Arm and control are the SAME checkpoint fine-tuned on the SAME rows for the SAME epochs; the only difference is whether the columns exist. A null here means the columns do not pay, not that the student was blind.
